screens.name: Home — no omen, omen fixture and entrance

findings: Give the faint example question a more stable visual presence during the entrance without competing with the orb.

screens.name: Onboarding — optional birthday
screens.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show labeled date parts, an external example and Skip; supplied evidence reports exact text scaling and serialized date validation.
findings: Keep the optional status and Skip action easy to discover after scrolling the enlarged form.

screens.name: Onboarding — age confirmation after Skip
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows explicit age choices; supplied age-confirmation evidence reports acceptance, decline, reload and prevention of requests before eligibility.
findings: Add a pictured 200% confirmation state to complete the visual evidence for this critical gate.

screens.name: Onboarding — age restriction
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show normal and enlarged restriction states with one recovery action; supplied evidence reports persistence and no bypass.
findings: Use an age-correction label that also makes sense when the user declined age confirmation without entering a birthday.

screens.name: Onboarding — birthday correction
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows normal and enlarged correction forms; supplied age-editor evidence reports validation, eligible correction and keyboard focus.
findings: Preserve the explicit eligibility explanation and the separate return-to-restriction action.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus unselected
screens.evidence: Sheets 17–18 show four choices and an enabled Meet the Ball action; supplied entry evidence reports keyboard selection.
findings: Clarify that Meet the Ball also continues without a selection, since the instruction says users may skip.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus selected
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows selection through a checkmark, gold text and separator at normal and enlarged sizes.
findings: Retain the checkmark alongside color so selection remains explicit.

screens.name: Approach — opening transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 2 shows the orb, opening status and next-step explanation; supplied motion evidence reports immediate approach under reduced motion.
findings: Keep this decorative transition brief so it does not delay reaching question entry.

screens.name: Ask — question composer
screens.evidence: Sheets 2 and 4 show normal and enlarged question entry; supplied evidence reports doubled input text, retained drafts and adequate targets.
findings: Reduce surplus blank editor space where possible to bring submission closer to the question at 200%.

screens.name: Ask — named-person editor
screens.evidence: Sheets 3–4 show explicit person modes and a labeled first-name field; supplied evidence reports validation, cancellation and a real request using saved Alex.
findings: Preserve the privacy explanation and explicit save step when switching the subject.

screens.name: Ask — saved named-person composer
screens.evidence: Sheets 3 and 21 show the saved question and About Alex control at both text sizes; supplied evidence reports question retention and focus return.
findings: Make the question's editability clearer when its unfocused appearance resembles static display text.

screens.name: Voice — unavailable with typing fallback
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show a microphone failure notice, prominent typing fallback and retry; supplied reading-extras evidence reports browser fallback success.
findings: Place a concise failure explanation nearer the fallback actions so recovery does not depend on noticing the distant bottom notice.

screens.name: Planning — loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 19–20 show phase-specific status, an expected wait and Cancel; supplied evidence reports timeout recovery and stopped animation under reduced motion.
findings: Preserve the visible cancellation path and the statement that failed generation spends no reading.

screens.name: Research — loading
screens.evidence: Sheet 23 shows research-specific supporting text within the same loading composition; supplied evidence reports real generation and cancellation checks.
findings: Keep the phase explanation visible so the repeated mist headline does not make progress appear stalled.

screens.name: Adaptive card 1 — plan readiness fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 5 shows the first question, four answer paths and progress; supplied evidence reports keyboard advancement and answer retention.
findings: Preserve the consistent option spacing and explicit free-response alternative.

screens.name: Adaptive card 2 — obstacle fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 5 shows the second question with stable option geometry and updated progress across the entrance pair.
findings: Keep the question and options anchored consistently as the card changes.

screens.name: Adaptive card 3 — support fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 6 shows the final synthetic card and its free-response option; supplied runtime notes distinguish this layout fixture from actual adaptive counts.
findings: Retain the textual progress indicator alongside the small progress strokes.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty and disabled
screens.evidence: Sheets 6–7 show a question-led editor, persistent answer label, requirement guidance and disabled Continue at normal and enlarged sizes.
findings: Preserve the visible requirement explanation beside the disabled action.

screens.name: Custom answer — populated, constrained 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 2 shows the compact question, answer, Back to choices and Reveal together; supplied forms evidence reports retained long answers at 390×500.
findings: Retain this compact composition while separately verifying real keyboard exposure on a phone.

screens.name: Planning error — retry and edit
screens.evidence: Sheet 8 shows a clear failure state with retry and editing; supplied runtime evidence reports no credit spent and successful retry.
findings: Soften the rectangular cutoff visible in the mist above the error-state orb.

screens.name: Prediction error — retry, review and edit
screens.evidence: Sheet 8 shows retry plus answer-review and question-editing recovery paths; supplied evidence reports retained answers and credits.
findings: Remove the visible hard edge in the orb's surrounding mist while retaining the recovery hierarchy.

screens.name: Sensitive question — planning redirect
screens.evidence: Sheet 25 shows a support action, alternate-question paths and explicit no-reading/no-memory consequences; supplied evidence reports a real sensitive redirect.
findings: Place the brief explanation before the support button so users understand the redirection before acting.

screens.name: Sensitive question — prediction redirect
screens.evidence: Sheet 26 shows the same support-first recovery structure after prediction, with visibly preserved no-spend messaging.
findings: Move the contextual explanation above the primary support action for a less abrupt interruption.

screens.name: Forecast — reveal

screens.name: Forecast — check-in unselected
screens.evidence: Sheet 7 shows three outcome choices and Share; supplied target evidence reports the corrected Yes control now meets 44×44.

screens.name: Forecast — Yes saved

screens.name: Forecast — Not quite saved

screens.name: Forecast — Not yet saved

screens.name: Evidence — overview

findings: Preserve the short descriptions that distinguish supplied answers, assumptions and background sources.

screens.name: Evidence — full reason reader
screens.evidence: Sheets 10 and 22 show the reason reader at both sizes; supplied evidence reports complete text equality, keyboard entry and return focus.
findings: Add short structural labels to distinguish recorded context, interpretation and limitations within long reasoning.

screens.name: Evidence — supplied answers reader
screens.evidence: Sheets 9 and 20 show separated answer sections and enlarged reader text; supplied evidence reports complete categories and accessible return navigation.

screens.name: Evidence — assumptions reader

screens.name: Evidence — sources reader

screens.name: Free forecast — Why reader
screens.evidence: Sheets 24–25 show a visible Back to forecast action and enlarged reason text; supplied evidence reports real-forecast reader and return-focus checks.

screens.name: Share — default export screen

limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments based on the supplied screenshots and runtime summary; no files or live interactions were independently inspected.
Each item's A and F are the normalized means of its three corresponding dimensions; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F rounded to one decimal, with null excluded only where genuinely inapplicable.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all screens and components.
No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence; content below a screenshot edge is not proof of an unreachable control, especially where supplied scroll and layout checks report success.
Entrance pairs support visual consistency at sampled moments but cannot independently establish continuous animation, focus timing or absence of intermediate shifts.
Reported browser target bounds, axe results and contrast checks support the scores but do not demonstrate novice usability or every assistive-technology interaction.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, real keyboard behavior, microphone operation, haptics and device performance remain unverified.
Payments are simulated, main Circles is offline, Sky uses samples, and browser PNG downloads do not prove native sharing or recipient delivery.
Synthetic predictions, repeated stress passages and fixture labels are not treated as production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
Some supplied behavioral evidence was retained from earlier rounds rather than rerun; its continued applicability is reported by the runtime summary and was not independently checked.
The previous constrained-composer failure and undersized Yes target remain part of the evidence history, although supplied current checks report both corrected.
No separately pictured date-removal confirmation, city-search results, active microphone capture, live Circle population or completed payment state was available to grade.
topFixes: Clarify unfocused question editability and distinguish Ask again from Edit question.
Add structural labels to long reasoning and bring source-opening links nearer publisher/date metadata.
Increase the useful size of share previews and make the scalable transcript easier to discover.
Consolidate duplicate notices and loading messages; label export recovery Retry download.
Make birth-city guidance match the current entry/search/selection step and make age-correction wording fit confirmation-only users.
Remove hard mist-crop edges and standardize secondary-action affordances and readable date formatting.
Complete missing enlarged critical-state visuals and the separately deferred physical-device accessibility checks.
